facts.fact: Egypt's Ministry of Transport added a digital accessibility service to its website mot.gov.eg with text-to-speech, speech-to-text, a sign-language interpreter, dyslexia fonts, a reading mask and keyboard navigation, working with the ICT ministry and the National Academy of IT for Persons with Disabilities.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Transport says it continues to develop its website and the websites of its affiliated authorities and companies for inclusion.
